players.product: RockBlock modular natural-gas generator systems (designed, assembled, installed and operated turnkey with Granite software) for on-site bridge / prime and backup power at AI data centers

quarterly_data.quarter: ERock press release: ERock, HD Construction Equipment Sign Multi-Year Engine (10-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Supplier HD Construction Equipment (described in the release as a subsidiary of Hyundai): ERock entered into a multi-year agreement for the supply of high-efficiency natural gas engine long blocks - the core of its proprietary RockBlock natural gas generators - spanning 2027 through 2028, to support increased production and large-scale customer orders for data centers, utilities and other critical infrastructure operators. CEO John Carrington: 'Long block supply is the foundation of our production and this agreement secures supply through 2028 as we ramp assembly capacity'; 'With production commitments extending into early 2028, delivering on schedule for our customers depends on securing the long-lead components'; the company views it as a foundation to build on as its needs grow beyond 2028.
quarterly_data.figure: engine long block supply 2027 through 2028; production commitments extending into early 2028
